brief: Prioritise this unit for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure (MG-023). Complete outstanding work orders in categories 1 through 3 before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows, and apply a loading restriction for category 4 items that cannot be completed (SOP-016). If the ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
